themes.name: Response Time / Lead Speed
themes.description: Businesses lose money because they respond too slowly to leads, calls, and inquiries
pain_examples: Real estate: 14-hour first response time → lost deals
SMBs: missed calls = direct lost revenue
Sales: time-to-contact is the bottleneck
Support: slow ticket response = churn
themes.current_solution: Manual checking, hiring VAs, basic auto-responders
themes.software_solution: Speed-to-lead agent: watches inbound forms/email/leads, scores urgency, responds immediately, routes to human
themes.mvp: One vertical + one CRM + one lead source + deterministic scoring + LLM for drafting

themes.name: Missed Calls / After-Hours Reception
themes.description: Small businesses lose revenue from calls they miss outside business hours
pain_examples: Dentists missing appointment bookings after 5pm
Salons missing booking requests on weekends
Trades missing emergency calls
Property managers missing tenant issues
themes.software_solution: AI receptionist: answers calls, qualifies, books, sends structured handoff to human
themes.mvp: One vertical + 10-20 intents + booking integration + escalation rules

themes.name: Invoice / Document Processing
themes.description: Manual processing of invoices, receipts, and documents wastes hours every week
pain_examples: 800 invoices/month manually processed
PDFs, receipts, bank exports manually copied to spreadsheets
Accountants spending hours on data entry
Bookkeepers matching deposits to invoices manually
themes.software_solution: Document normalizer: PDF/CSV/email → structured data → accounting software
themes.mvp: Email/folder → OCR/extraction → validation → CSV/API → human review queue

themes.name: Bookkeeping / Reconciliation
themes.description: Matching deposits to invoices, categorizing expenses, chasing overdue payments
pain_examples: Small business owner: payment chasing, matching deposits, receipts, categorization
QBO + Stripe still requires substantial manual entry
Month-end close is painful and repetitive
themes.software_solution: Bookkeeping exception agent: match deposits, categorize, chase payments, flag anomalies
themes.mvp: One accounting software + bank feed + deterministic matching + LLM for categorization

themes.name: PPC / Ad Campaign Management
themes.description: Ad agencies spend hours on reporting, pacing, anomaly detection, and client summaries
pain_examples: PPC practitioners: reporting, invoicing, pacing, issue-catching
Manual Google Ads optimization is tedious
Client reporting takes hours each week
themes.current_solution: Manual monitoring, basic scripts, hiring media buyers
themes.software_solution: PPC monitoring agent: monitors spend/pacing/anomalies, creates daily digest, flags issues
themes.mvp: Google Ads read-only monitor + daily digest + anomaly rules + change log

themes.name: MSP / IT Ticket Triage
themes.description: MSPs waste time on ticket classification, context gathering, and routing
pain_examples: 30 minutes saved per complex ticket
Ticket triage is the clearest production AI use case
IT managers: repetitive tasks eat the day
themes.current_solution: Manual triage, basic routing rules, hiring more staff
themes.software_solution: IT ticket triage agent: reads tickets, gathers context, classifies severity, proposes fixes, routes
themes.mvp: Read-only integrations + evidence packet + classification + routing

themes.name: CRM / Email Operations
themes.description: Updating CRM from email is tedious and error-prone
pain_examples: Email-to-CRM updating is deliberately boring automation that works
Sales teams waste hours on data entry
Agencies need to track client communications
themes.software_solution: Email-to-CRM agent: extracts entities/status/next action, updates CRM fields/tasks
themes.mvp: One CRM + email integration + entity extraction + field mapping

themes.name: Onboarding / Signup Recovery
themes.description: Users abandon signups and onboarding flows, losing revenue
pain_examples: Incomplete onboarding = lost revenue
SaaS: users sign up but never complete setup
Multi-step signup has high drop-off
themes.software_solution: Onboarding recovery agent: detects incomplete setup, contacts user, answers blockers, guides to completion
themes.mvp: Email/SMS detection + outreach + routing to human
themes.monetization: Performance-based (% of recovered signups) or monthly

themes.name: SEO / AI Search Visibility
themes.description: Businesses want to rank in AI search but have no measurement tools
pain_examples: All my boss wants is to rank in AI
No tools to measure AI search visibility
SEO practitioners can't prove AI mentions
themes.software_solution: AI search visibility agent: runs prompt sets, measures mentions/citations, tracks changes
themes.mvp: Controlled prompt sets + evidence screenshots + longitudinal tracking

themes.name: Property Management Operations
themes.description: Property managers buried in maintenance follow-up, vendor chasing, tenant updates
pain_examples: Maintenance follow-up loop buries teams
Chasing vendors and updating frustrated tenants
Manual work after every meeting
themes.software_solution: PM operations agent: ticket classification → vendor follow-up → tenant updates → escalation
themes.mvp: Webhook → classifier → checklist → timer → update generator → dashboard

themes.name: Recruiting / Candidate Sourcing
themes.description: Recruiters waste time on low-quality candidate results and ATS hygiene
pain_examples: Sourcing tools return huge low-fit result sets
ATS hygiene/reporting expectations rising
Resume parsing failures common
themes.current_solution: LinkedIn Recruiter, manual screening, basic ATS
themes.software_solution: Recruiter sourcing agent: role → criteria → rank candidates → update ATS → draft outreach
themes.mvp: One ATS + one job board + criteria extraction + ranking + outreach drafting

themes.name: SME Automation / Workflow Integration
themes.description: Small businesses have scattered tools, brittle workflows, nobody owns the system
pain_examples: Disconnected tools, brittle workflows, nobody owning the full system
Scattered scripts, weak documentation, no standardized automations
Spreadsheets, dashboards, PM tools = chaos
$6K offered for GoHighLevel+n8n+Make automation architecture
themes.software_solution: Automation-stack owner: connects tools, creates workflows, monitors, maintains
themes.mvp: One integration (e.g. Shopify+Gmail) + workflow automation + monitoring

pattern_summary.most_recurring_pain: Manual data entry and document processing
